name: pagode-remote
description: Standalone Capacitor app: BLE remote for the Pagode (DSD TECH 2-channel BLE relay, SH-HC-08). Wrapped UI is the single source HTML/pagode/pagode.html (START/STOP car remote, snakeskin/gold); `npm run prep` copies page + js/pagode-ble.js + snakeskin.png into www/ before sync. See ../Solita_goes_Pagode.md.

scripts.prep: mkdir -p www/js && cp ../HTML/pagode/pagode.html www/index.html && cp ../HTML/pagode/js/pagode-ble.js www/js/pagode-ble.js && cp ../HTML/pagode/js/pagode-auth.js www/js/pagode-auth.js && cp ../HTML/pagode/snakeskin.png www/snakeskin.png
scripts.cap:add: npm run prep && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prep && npx cap sync android
